mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the Consumer Price Index (CPI) indicates elevated inflation, which typically leads to higher real interest rates and reduced equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between CPIAUCSL and 20-day S&P 500 returns is >= -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 0.5% signals a monetary tightening cycle, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day S&P 500 returns is >= -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the unemployment rate and deceleration in employment growth (measured by PAYEMS) signals a deteriorating labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE increases and PAYEMS growth rate decreases, the Rank IC between the joint signal and 20-day S&P 500 returns is >= -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a high level of real GDP (GDPC1) indicates the economy is near its peak, which typically leads to reduced corporate earnings growth and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, the Rank IC between GDPC1 and 20-day S&P 500 returns is >= -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing and economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between INDPRO and 20-day S&P 500 returns is <= 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 800,000 units signals a weakening housing market, which reduces consumer confidence and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 800.0, the Rank IC between HOUST and 5-day S&P 500 returns is >= -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising CPIAUCSL combined with a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals an impending monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL is rising and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, the Rank IC between the joint signal and 60-day S&P 500 returns is >= -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A falling unemployment rate below 6.5% signals a strong labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE < 6.5%, the Rank IC between UNRATE and 60-day S&P 500 returns is <= 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
